name: cover-flow
title: Cover Flow
summary: Browse the album covers in 3D, as on the iPod classic.
description: Shows the album covers as Cover Flow. Hold the Select button in the Albums list to open it.
details: Hold the Select button in the Albums list for half a second. Cover Flow opens at the selected album.
Turn the click wheel to move through the covers. Each cover gives the click of the lists.
The album name and the artist show below the covers, in the font of the iPod.
Push Select to open the album at the centre.
Push Menu to go back to the Albums list.
A short push of Select in the list opens the album as usual.
The background is white with the light theme and black with Dark Mode.
requires: Album artwork on the iPod from iTunes or Finder. An album without artwork shows a grey square.
notes: Cover Flow uses the artwork, the albums and the names that the iPod already has. You do not have to write a file after a sync.
In the Albums list, a long push of Select does not add the album to the On-The-Go playlist.
